before.name: Toxic Release Inventory on-site releases per capita
before.source: EPA Toxics Release Inventory (TRI) Program — Envirofacts data service (TRI_FACILITY, TRI_REPORTING_FORM, TRI_RELEASE_QTY tables), reporting year 2024, cross-checked against all historically Bronx-registered facilities; population from NYS Dept. of Health Annual Population Estimates (Census Bureau-derived postcensal estimate)

scoring.worked_math: Numerator (Bronx County on-site TRI releases, reporting year 2024): checked all 27 facilities ever registered in Bronx County (FIPS 36005) in EPA's TRI_FACILITY master list; only 1 had an active RY2024 filing — SPRAGUE BRONX TERMINAL (10454CSTLL939E1), a Harlem River petroleum terminal. Per-chemical on-site releases (AIR FUG + AIR STACK + WATER, from TRI_RELEASE_QTY): 1,2,4-Trimethylbenzene 151.39+186.28+2.52=340.19 lbs; Polycyclic aromatic compounds 0+0.0019+0.0179=0.0198 lbs; Benzo[g,h,i]perylene 0+0.00004+0.00378=0.00382 lbs; Xylene (mixed isomers) 1015.53+0.01+0.01=1015.55 lbs; Naphthalene and Ethylbenzene were reported on Form A (short form; certifies releases below 500 lbs, no quantitative breakdown disclosed, treated as 0). Total = 340.19+0.0198+0.00382+1015.55 = 1,355.76 lbs. Denominator: Bronx County population, 2024 postcensal estimate (NYS DOH via data.ny.gov, Census Bureau-derived) = 1,406,052. Per capita = 1,355.76 / 1,406,052 = 0.000964 lbs/resident/year. level_pct = (0.000964 − 1) / 1 × 100 = −99.90

after.name: Quantified TRI Form R on-site releases per capita
after.source: US EPA TRI Basic Data Files 2024; US Census county population Vintage 2025
after.notes: EPA reportingyear 2024 quantified Form R releases 1355.76362 lb / July 1,2024 Census Vintage 2025 population 1406052. 2 Form A records have unquantified releases, not measured zeros. The configured total TRI-release metric therefore remains incompletely quantified. No score asserted for this qualified observed lowerbound. Reporting thresholds and coveredindustries restrict TRI coverage.
